reason: E-Golf4U is going away, so I have to pick the system that runs our whole administration for the next ten years, and I have to pick it now. I can't put a 950-member club on two founders who don't have one club live yet. Your pilot assumes I keep working in my current system, but mine is the one disappearing.
objection: Nobody is running on it yet. Zwolle hasn't even started, so there's no results page and no board I can call. Meanwhile Nexxchange and IntoGolf run hundreds of clubs. If the migration goes wrong mid-season, it's me standing at the desk and in front of the members' meeting. The escrow and the exports are nice on paper, but they don't keep the tee sheet working on a Saturday morning.
would_change_my_mind: A club our size that is fully live on Greenside, with E-Golf4U switched off and a full season behind it, whose board tells me on the phone that invoicing, competitions and the SEPA run all worked without problems.
